##### Source: [Feats for the Fearsome](https://www.patreon.com/posts/feats-for-16156471) (Dilettante)

With a few minutes of preparation, a bit of improvisation, and some talent, you can appear proficient in just about anything. When you finish a long rest, you can spend 10 minutes practicing with a skill or tool to become proficient in it until you finish a long rest.
